  <strong>CI scripts</strong> - linted workflow and deployment commands

---

Workflow shell logic lives here so it can be formatted with `shfmt`, checked
with ShellCheck, and kept out of the workflow YAML.

CI verifies the hash of every `*.sh` file before running any of them. Reviewed
script changes require an explicit update to `CI_SCRIPTS_SHA256`:

```bash
checksum=$(find .github/scripts -type f -name '*.sh' -print0 \
  | sort -z \
  | xargs -0 sha256sum \
  | sha256sum \
  | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
gh variable set CI_SCRIPTS_SHA256 --body "$checksum"
```

Lint the scripts locally with:

```bash
bash .github/scripts/lint.sh
```
